ModMetaData.name: Silooth Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Replaces mlie.starwarsanimalcollection's Silooth adult art (south/east/north facings only; the larva, juvenile stage and dessicated corpse stay on donor art) with the canon Sith warbeast redraw picked by the owner 2026-10-09 (v6): six stilt legs, tall swept shell, horn-like mandibles rooted on the brow, acid spray. ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (swanimals/Silooth/Silooth_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
